brief:
Shehab Wire reported that the West Bank and East Jerusalem witnessed 56 resistance operations during the week of August 7–13, 2026, according to a weekly compilation released by the Palestinian Information Center Mada. The tally documented activity across both territories over the seven-day span.

The Palestinian Information Center Mada tracks such operations on a regular basis. The August report marked the latest in a series of weekly assessments covering resistance activity in occupied Palestinian territories. No breakdown of the operations by location, type, or outcome was included in the report.

title: West Bank and Jerusalem record 56 resistance operations in a week
